mechanism: Ethambutol can cause hyperuricemia and may impair niacin metabolism, while niacin's vasodilatory effects may potentiate ethambutol-related adverse effects; both drugs can cause peripheral neuropathy.
action: Monitor for signs of peripheral neuropathy, hyperuricemia, and gout; consider alternative antituberculous regimen if neuropathy develops; ensure adequate pyridoxine supplementation.
